lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਗੁਰੂ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis no daiaal hovai meraa suaamee tis gurasikh guroo upades sunaavai ||
lines.translation: That person, unto whom my Lord and Master is kind and compassionate - upon that GurSikh, the Guru's Teachings are bestowed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਧੂੜਿ ਮੰਗੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਕੀ ਜੋ ਆਪਿ ਜਪੈ ਅਵਰਹ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak dhooR ma(n)gai tis gurasikh kee jo aap japai avarah naam japaavai ||2||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak begs for the dust of the feet of that GurSikh, who himself chants the Naam, and inspires others to chant it. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਸੇ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਥੋੜੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo tudh sach dhiaaide se virale thoRe ||
lines.translation: Those who meditate on You, O True Lord - they are very rare.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਇਕੁ ਅਰਾਧਦੇ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਬਰਕਤਿ ਖਾਹਿ ਅਸੰਖ ਕਰੋੜੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo man chit ik araadhade tin kee barakat khaahi asa(n)kh karoRe ||
lines.translation: Those who worship and adore the One Lord in their conscious minds - through their generosity, countless millions are fed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁਨੋ ਸਭ ਧਿਆਇਦੀ ਸੇ ਥਾਇ ਪਏ ਜੋ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਲੋੜੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tudhuno sabh dhiaaidee se thaai pae jo saahib loRe ||
lines.translation: All meditate on You, but they alone are accepted, who are pleasing to their Lord and Master.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਖਾਦੇ ਪੈਨਦੇ ਸੇ ਮੁਏ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੇ ਕੋੜ੍ਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo bin satigur seve khaade painade se mue mar ja(n)me koRhe ||
lines.translation: Those who eat and dress without serving the True Guru die; after death, those wretched lepers are consigned to reincarnation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਹਾਜਰੁ ਮਿਠਾ ਬੋਲਦੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਵਿਸੁ ਕਢਹਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਘੋਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: oi haajar mithaa bolade baahar vis kadhahi mukh ghole ||
lines.translation: In His Sublime Presence, they talk sweetly, but behind His back, they exude poison from their mouths.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਖੋਟੇ ਦਯਿ ਵਿਛੋੜੇ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: man khote day vichhoRe ||11||
lines.translation: The evil-minded are consigned to separation from the Lord. ||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਲੁ ਜੂਈ ਭਰਿਆ ਨੀਲਾ ਕਾਲਾ ਖਿਧੋਲੜਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਵੇਮੁਖਿ ਵੇਮੁਖੈ ਨੋ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: mal jooee bhariaa neelaa kaalaa khidholaRaa tin vemukh vemukhai no paaiaa ||
lines.translation: The faithless baymukh sent out his faithless servant, wearing a blue-black coat, filled with filth and vermin.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਸਿ ਨ ਦੇਈ ਕੋਈ ਬਹਣਿ ਜਗਤ ਮਹਿ ਗੂਹ ਪੜਿ ਸਗਵੀ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਇ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: paas na deee koee bahan jagat mahi gooh paR sagavee mal laai manamukh aaiaa ||
lines.translation: No one in the world will sit near him; the self-willed manmukh fell into manure, and returned with even more filth covering him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰਾਈ ਜੋ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਚੁਗਲੀ ਨੋ ਵੇਮੁਖੁ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਭੇਜਿਆ ਓਥੈ ਭੀ ਮੁਹੁ ਕਾਲਾ ਦੁਹਾ ਵੇਮੁਖਾ ਦਾ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: paraaee jo ni(n)daa chugalee no vemukh kar kai bhejiaa othai bhee muhu kaalaa duhaa vemukhaa daa karaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The faithless baymukh was sent to slander and back-bite others, but when he went there, the faces of both he and his faithless master were blackened instead.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੜ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਸਭਤੁ ਜਗਤ ਵਿਚਿ ਭਾਈ ਵੇਮੁਖੁ ਸਣੈ ਨਫਰੈ ਪਉਲੀ ਪਉਦੀ ਫਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਉਠਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: taR suniaa sabhat jagat vich bhaaee vemukh sanai napharai paulee paudee phaavaa hoi kai uth ghar aaiaa ||
lines.translation: It was immediately heard throughout the whole world, O Siblings of Destiny, that this faithless man, along with his servant, was kicked and beaten with shoes; in humiliation, they got up and returned to their homes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗੈ ਸੰਗਤੀ ਕੁੜਮੀ ਵੇਮੁਖੁ ਰਲਣਾ ਨ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਵਹੁਟੀ ਭਤੀਜਂੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਣਿ ਘਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: agai sa(n)gatee kuRamee vemukh ralanaa na milai taa vahutee bhateeja(n)ee phir aan ghar paaiaa ||
lines.translation: The faithless baymukh was not allowed to mingle with others; his wife and niece then brought him home to lie down.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਦੋਵੈ ਗਏ ਨਿਤ ਭੁਖਾ ਕੂਕੇ ਤਿਹਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: halat palat dovai gae nit bhukhaa kooke tihaaiaa ||
lines.translation: He has lost both this world and the next; he cries out continually, in hunger and thirst.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਨਿਆਉ ਸਚੁ ਬਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhan dhan suaamee karataa purakh hai jin niaau sach bahi aap karaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Blessed, blessed is the Creator, the Primal Being, our Lord and Master; He Himself sits and dispenses true justice.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਸੋ ਸਾਚੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਚਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo ni(n)daa kare satigur poore kee so saachai maar pachaaiaa ||
lines.translation: One who slanders the Perfect True Guru is punished and destroyed by the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਅਖਰੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਆਖਿਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ehu akhar tin aakhiaa jin jagat sabh upaaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: This Word is spoken by the One who created the whole universe. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਨੰਗਾ ਭੁਖਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਨਫਰੁ ਕਿਥਹੁ ਰਜਿ ਖਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: saahib jis kaa na(n)gaa bhukhaa hovai tis daa naphar kithahu raj khaae ||
lines.translation: One who has a poor beggar for a master - how can he be well-fed?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਵਥੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਨਫਰੈ ਹਥਿ ਆਵੈ ਅਣਹੋਦੀ ਕਿਥਹੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: j saahib kai ghar vath hovai s napharai hath aavai anahodee kithahu paae ||
lines.translation: If there is something in his master's house, he can get it; but how can he get what is not there?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਦੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕੀਤੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਸਾ ਸੇਵਾ ਅਉਖੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis dee sevaa keetee phir lekhaa ma(n)geeai saa sevaa aukhee hoee ||
lines.translation: Serving him, who will be called to answer for his account? That service is painful and useless.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਫਲ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sevaa karahu har gur saphal darasan kee phir lekhaa ma(n)gai na koee ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, serve the Guru, the Lord Incarnate; the Blessed Vision of His Darshan is profitable, and in the end, you shall not be called to account. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵੀਚਾਰਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਚਾਰਿ ਵੇਦ ਕਹੰਦੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak veechaarahi sa(n)t jan chaar ved kaha(n)de ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Saints consider, and the four Vedas proclaim,

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਮੁਖੈ ਤੇ ਬੋਲਦੇ ਸੇ ਵਚਨ ਹੋਵੰਦੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat mukhai te bolade se vachan hova(n)de ||
lines.translation: that whatever the Lord's devotees utter with their mouths, shall come to pass.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਪਹਾਰਾ ਜਾਪਦਾ ਸਭਿ ਲੋਕ ਸੁਣੰਦੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: pragat pahaaraa jaapadaa sabh lok suna(n)de ||
lines.translation: He is manifest in His cosmic workshop. All people hear of this.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਮੁਗਧ ਨਰ ਸੰਤ ਨਾਲਿ ਖਹੰਦੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sukh na paain mugadh nar sa(n)t naal khaha(n)de ||
lines.translation: The stubborn men who fight with the Saints shall never find peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਲੋਚਨਿ ਓਨਾ ਗੁਣੈ ਨੋ ਓਇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਸੜੰਦੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: oi lochan onaa gunai no oi aha(n)kaar saRa(n)de ||
lines.translation: The Saints seek to bless them with virtue, but they only burn in their egos.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਜਾ ਭਾਗ ਧੁਰਿ ਮੰਦੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: oi vichaare kiaa karahi jaa bhaag dhur ma(n)de ||
lines.translation: What can those wretched ones do, since, from the very beginning, their destiny is cursed with evil.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਿਨਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਸੇ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਸੰਦੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo maare tin paarabraham se kisai na sa(n)de ||
lines.translation: Those who are struck down by the Supreme Lord God are of no use to anyone.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵੈਰੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਿਰਵੈਰ ਨਾਲਿ ਧਰਮ ਨਿਆਇ ਪਚੰਦੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vair karahi niravair naal dharam niaai pacha(n)de ||
lines.translation: Those who hate the One who has no hatred - according to the true justice of Dharma, they shall perish.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਸੰਤਿ ਸਰਾਪਿਆ ਸੇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਭਵੰਦੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo jo sa(n)t saraapiaa se phirahi bhava(n)de ||
lines.translation: Those who are cursed by the Saints will continue wandering aimlessly.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੇਡੁ ਮੁੰਢਾਹੂੰ ਕਟਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਡਾਲ ਸੁਕੰਦੇ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: ped mu(n)dhaahoo(n) katiaa tis daal suka(n)de ||12||
lines.translation: When the tree is cut off at its roots, the branches wither and die. ||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Salok Fourth Mehl:
